title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the code-datasource predicates out of protocol.ts into protocol-code-datasource-predicates.ts (#25467 cut 28)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7JKgiM29GUcitRvoGGj5BU)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

Cut 28 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). Cuts 1–27 landed as #25494, #25518, #25538, #25589, #25601, #25623, #25642, #25719, #25731, #25740, #25797, #25939, #25972, #26014, #26104, #26168, #26264, #26317, #26350, #26366, #26404, #26449, #26654, #26704, #26807, #26873 and #26933. The claim is `6455477257`. It takes the cut 28 proposal of the cut 27 report (`6454673268`), a themed pair. Both members passed the AST screen and the read-seam census, and both moved unedited.

Two `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` members move unedited into one new module, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-code-datasource-predicates.ts` (#23050 shape B). They are the protocol's two answers to "is this datasource name defined in code?":

- `isDeclaredCodeDatasource` (#21899): does an installed package declare it, or does the host register it from code?
- `isHostCodeDatasource` (#21944): the host's code-datasource set alone, read from the `code-datasource-names` service.

`protocol.ts` keeps its 29,384 lines: the 15 body lines that left are replaced by 13 stub lines and the 2-line import. The cut is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` is the harness-pinned branch for this thread. It was restarted from `main` `aa00362fe5` (after cut 27's merge). It names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record. It holds the move commit `a967328ee5` and, as the claim asked, one merge of `main`, `4dbdd32a06` (13 commits). That merge touches one test file of this package, `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts` (#26928), and not `protocol.ts`. The merged tree was still measured against `main` (see "The merged tree against `main`").

## Serial with the file's in-flight PRs

The claim named **#26920** as the open PR that also edits `protocol.ts` and asked for a `git merge-tree` against it before this PR was opened.

- **#26920** (head `d1002180ce`) edits `protocol.ts` at `:16157–16210` and `:20210` (+54 / −17), plus 7 more files of this package. It names neither moved member. This cut's hunks are at `:420` (the import) and `:15675–15701`.
- Its `git merge-tree` against this head `4dbdd32a06` is **clean**.
- That merged tree was built and type-checked: `git merge-tree` to a tree, then `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol` on that tree exits 0. On it, both moved bodies still compare 240 tokens, 0 differ.
- Its merge-tree against `main` alone is clean too. The conflict cut 27 reported for #26920 is gone, since #26920 has merged `main` since then.

All 32 open PRs were checked against this head as well. Six touch this package, and none names either member:

- **#26953** (`metadata-diagnostics.ts` and a test), **#26937** (one test), **#26556** and **#26517** (`package.json` / `CHANGELOG.md`): merge-tree clean.
- **#26831** (one test, `protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts`) conflicts, but **not with this cut**. It conflicts with `main` alone the same way, as cut 27 reported.

`main` has not moved since the merge (0 behind at the derivation).

## The order's screen (private statics, `new Error(`, the read-seam census)

Both members passed:

- **No private-static read.** The AST walk found no access on the `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` identifier and none on `this.constructor`.
- **No error constructed.** Neither body has `new Error(`, so no `PRODUCERS` row is owed.
- **Read-seam census.** `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list` was taken on the base and again on the cut: `88 read seam(s)` and an identical list once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped. The full readings, including the merged tree's 89, are under "The durability `--list`".

## What moves

| Member | Base line | Visibility | Body lines | AST tokens (params + return + body) | Reads |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `isDeclaredCodeDatasource` | `:15675` | private | 12 | 157 | `engine` (field); `isHostCodeDatasource` (method); module-level `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR` |
| `isHostCodeDatasource` | `:15697` | private | 3 | 83 | `getServicesRegistry` (field); module-level `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR` |

`protocol-code-datasource-predicates.ts` has 82 lines.

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1–27 apply it)

- **The class keeps both members.** Each keeps its name, docblock, signature and position. Each body now delegates, marked `[#25467 cut 28]`.
- **`CodeDatasourcePredicatesHost`** types the three members the bodies read as the class members themselves (`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation['engine']`, `['getServicesRegistry']` and `['isHostCodeDatasource']`). Each function's `this` is a `Pick` of the members it reads.
- **The `engine` and `getServicesRegistry` fields are handed over as getters** (the hand-over of cuts 16, 20, 24, 26 and 27). So each read finds them at call time, as before.
- **`isDeclaredCodeDatasource`'s call to `isHostCodeDatasource` is handed over as a closure**, `(...a) => this.isHostCodeDatasource(...a)`, as the claim asked. So that call still reaches the class method (now its stub), not the moved function directly.
- **No member changes visibility.**
- **Every caller still calls the class method.** None changes:
  - `isDeclaredCodeDatasource`: `isArtifactBacked` (`:15484`, base) and cut 10's `declinesStoredRow` stub closure (`:15996`). The closure is typed by `protocol-lock-state.ts`'s `LockStateHost`, which indexes the class member.
  - `isHostCodeDatasource`: `isDeclaredCodeDatasource` (above) and `:28556`.

## Module-level declarations, by reader: no import leaves `protocol.ts`

Measured by an AST walk over each body's identifiers, against `protocol.ts`'s top-level declarations and import bindings (property names excluded): the one module-level name the bodies read is `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR`, from `@objectstack/spec/shared`. It has 54 code references left in `protocol.ts` and stays; the new module imports it from there too. So the top level of `protocol.ts` changes by the new module's import alone. No import comment moves.

## The published `.d.ts`

The series bar is ruling `6348891160`: sorted-union identity, measured first, with raw identity reported when it holds. **Both hold for this cut**, including on the merged tree against `main`. The cut adds one import statement and its comment ahead of every class docblock, so the cut 25 comment-offset trap was watched. It did not fire: the raw hash is identical at both ends.

Base `aa00362fe5` and head `a967328ee5` were built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` against one dependency tree. The closure was built at head by a full `pnpm build` (116/116). For the base build, the package's `src/` was swapped tree-only to base (the new module removed) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap. Afterwards `git diff HEAD` was empty, `git status` was clean, and both touched blobs equalled `HEAD`'s.

- **Normalised sha256** (the ruling's bar): `a9338265ddd795ccfd7fda56ee209f3c2e162f9153766351149994f20e92715f` at both ends, on `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`. The normaliser sorted 80 string-literal union runs. **Sorted-union identity holds.**
- **Raw sha256**: `7307bcccb6026da6c004fa2daaca634d3419d202d6b742c122a7a3c64a552712` at both ends, 781,687 bytes. **Raw identity holds.**
- **The two builds differ where they should.**
  - `index.js` hashes `c256da7d953a800b…` at base and `2eae069e2f6b4a9f…` at head (`index.cjs` `c51a78c2b343bd49…` → `181916e28805d9b5…`).
  - `….call(host` goes 0 → 1 for each of the two members in both bundles.
  - Each `function …(` declaration goes 0 → 1.
- **Positive control** on the head tree. `private` was dropped from `isHostCodeDatasource` on disk (restored from `HEAD` under a trap) and the package rebuilt. Both `.d.ts` files move to `6bbad327ad411fb0…` (normalised `25b39e1f5e8cc68f…`, which differs from the bar's `a9338265…`) and print `isHostCodeDatasource(type: string, name: string): boolean;`. So the bar can see a change on these members.
- **Export tables.** The ESM and CJS bundles, loaded at runtime from the package, each export the same 78 names at base and head. The sorted list hashes to `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on all of them. Neither function, and not `CodeDatasourcePredicatesHost`, appears.

### The merged tree against `main`

The merged tree `4dbdd32a06` was measured against `main` `912076f885`, its second parent, in the same way. The closure was rebuilt by a full `pnpm build` (116/116), and `main`'s package `src/` was swapped in tree-only and restored under a trap. The merged tree differs from `main` only by this cut: 2 files, +97 / −15.

- **`.d.ts`**: raw `7307bcccb6026da6…` (781,687 bytes) and normalised `a9338265ddd795cc…`, the same at `main` and merged. Both identities hold.
- **`index.js`**: `c256da7d953a800b…` at `main`, `2eae069e2f6b4a9f…` merged. Export tables: 78 names, `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on both.
- **AST compare**, `main`'s `protocol.ts` against the merged one: 240 tokens, 0 differ.
- **Suite**: `main` and merged both give 21,742 tests (21,716 passed, 0 failed, 26 skipped, 278 files), per test identical.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

## The durability `--list`

`check-durability-degradation-log-level` exits 0 at both ends with identical output: `88 read seam(s)` at both ends. Its `--list` is **identical once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped** (164 lines, and no entry changes file).

- Neither body has a `try` or reads the gate's read vocabulary (`find`/`findOne`/`count`).
- No seam enters or leaves the census through this cut.
- **On the merged tree the census reads 89, and so does `main`.** The extra seam is `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` (`runPredicateDelete()` guarded in `delete()`, from #26930), which `main` brought in. `main`'s `--list` and the merged tree's are identical once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped (165 lines). So this cut adds or removes nothing on either tree. The claim's "stay at 88" holds for base → cut, and `main` itself moved to 89.

## Proof of move-only

**Bodies, by AST token.** The compare reads the TypeScript compiler's AST leaf tokens, with JSDoc skipped, over the parameters (less the added `this`), the return type and the body. It compares base `protocol.ts` at `aa00362fe5` against the head module:

```
isDeclaredCodeDatasource: base tokens 157, head tokens 157, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
isHostCodeDatasource: base tokens 83, head tokens 83, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
TOTAL tokens=240 differ=0 members=2
CLASS members base=303 head=303 order-same=true byte-identical=301 stubs-with-identical-docblock+signature=2 other=[]
TOP base=261 head=262 byte-identical=261
```

**Negative controls**, one per member. Each changed one token in an in-memory copy of the head module, and only the mutated member moved (differ 1; the other stayed 0):

```
"!== 'function') return false;"     -> "!== 'object') …"           isDeclaredCodeDatasource differ 1
"get('code-datasource-names')"      -> "get('code-datasource-name')"  isHostCodeDatasource differ 1
```

- **Class side.** There are 303 members at base and at head, in the same order. The 301 that did not move are byte-identical to base, leading comments included. Both stubs sit at their base positions and keep their docblocks and signatures byte-identical.
- **Top level of `protocol.ts`.** All 261 base statements are byte-identical, leading comments included. Head adds one statement, the new module's import.
- **Size.** +97 / −15 over 2 files, 112 changed lines (the claim's estimate was 80–130).

## Readers of the moved lines

These were grepped for the two member names and for the bodies' distinctive text (`code-datasource-names`, `getAllPackages`, `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR[type]`, `#21899`, `#21944`):

- the 24 files that name `protocol.ts` and call `readFileSync`;
- the test files in `packages/`, `docs/qa/` and `scripts/`;
- the `@objectstack/spec` liveness ledgers.

- **By path: none reads a moved line.** No by-path reader names either member or that text.
- **The other files naming them:** `protocol-lock-state.ts` (cut 10's `LockStateHost`, which indexes the class member, so it is unchanged) and `packages/runtime/src/code-datasource-names.ts` (comments).
- **`isArtifactBacked` is pinned** by `protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts`. It is not in this cut, and its `this.isDeclaredCodeDatasource(` call text is unchanged.
- **Behaviour, no edit owed.** These drive the predicates through the protocol and pass at both ends, in the package suite: `protocol.code-defined-datasource-door.test.ts`, `protocol.declines-stored-row-published.test.ts` and `protocol.reads-environment-only.test.ts`.
- **The liveness ledgers.** No row points at either member. Carried forward: `manifest.json`'s `dependencies` row → `protocol.ts#resolveWritePackageScope` (cut 19), and `seed.json` → `protocol.ts#applySeedBodies` (cut 14). These are `packages/spec/**`, outside this card.
- **ADR anchors.** `check-adr-anchors` exits 0 with identical output at both ends (1,896 decision-letter citations, 60,021 citations). No moved line cites an ADR.
- **Engine-double contract** (`check-engine-double-contract`): exits 0 at both ends.
  - The `updateData`/`deleteData` seams keep their entries at new line numbers (14003 → 14005, 14028 → 14030).
  - `productionFiles` is 3,816 at base and 3,818 at head. The +2 are the new file and the gitignored `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` that the spec build writes in the head tree, as in cuts 20–27.
- **Identical output at both ends:** `check-adr-anchors`, `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-query-options-erasure-ratchet`, `check-filter-alias-parity` and `check-durability-degradation-log-level`. `check-nul-bytes` differs only in the scanned file count, +1. The base-end readings were taken in a clean detached worktree at `aa00362fe5`.

## Verification

- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 at head, on the merged tree, and on the merge-tree with #26920.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 with no output (the whole touched package, with the root `lint` script's flags).
- **`packages/metadata-protocol` suite**, compared per test name and status. Each leg ran vitest `--maxWorkers=2` with the JSON reporter under the shared verify lock.
  - Base `aa00362fe5`: 21,738 tests (21,712 passed, 0 failed, 26 skipped), 278 files.
  - Head `a967328ee5`: 21,738 tests (21,712 passed, 0 failed, 26 skipped), 278 files.
  - None lost, none added, none changed status. The base leg is the package `src/` swapped tree-only from `aa00362fe5` (the new module removed) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap.
  - The merged head `4dbdd32a06` and `main` `912076f885` both give 21,742 tests, per test identical (0 lost, 0 added, 0 changed).
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` (merged tree): OK, 31 anchors judged, 0 lost.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges --branch claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` finds 0 of 2 paths in the register (13 surfaces), so the PR is NOT governed. It has 112 changed lines, under the 3,000-line human-merge bar.
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 46 gates on 2 changed paths from `4dbdd32a06`, with no stale-tree finding. All 46 exit 0 after the full `pnpm build` (116/116). `dispatch-gates --ran` reports 46 derived, 46 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED and 0 UNRUN, and exits 0.

## Carry-forward

These stay in `protocol.ts`:

- **The read-seam members** (cut 21): `findEnvironmentRows`, `packagelessAddress`, `findServedOverlayRow`, `foldStoredCollection`, `applyObjectRegistryMutation`, `unmanagedImportCollisions`, `rollBackUnmanagedImport`, `readRevertableCommit` and `storedFlowBindingAgrees`. `rethrowUnlessMetadataStoreUnprovisioned` cannot move at all. `findEnvironmentRow` joins them: a census trial moving it drops the count by 7.
- Public members whose return type is inferred.
- **The bodies kept by a by-path reader:**
  - `probeRecord`, `getMetaItemCached`, `findReferencesToMeta`, `refuseUnmintableMetaType` and `metaTypeNamespaceExists`.
  - `viewContainerNameCollisionRefusal` with `overlaidShippedContainerViewNames`, and `reportPageRequiresAbsentAtLoad`.
  - The 7 `applyRegistryWriteThrough` callers, `readCodeLayerForCarryForward` and `ensureObjectStorage`.
  - `emitMetadataMutation`, `isArtifactBacked` and `isNestedArtifactField` (the `lookupArtifactItem` site pins), and `getOverlayRepo`.
- The private-static readers: `refusePackagedBaseRemoval`, `packagedBaseRefusal`, `runPublishSideEffects`, `promoteDraftForPublish`, `publishPackageDrafts` and `discardPackageDrafts`.
- The field writers: `warnClosureReadUnavailable` and `resolveSduiManifest`.
